---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Job Copilot
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please provide a clear and concise description of the issue or workflow friction.
*Example: I am frustrated when tracking multiple applications because...*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen or how the feature should work.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Affected Components
Check the areas of the repository this feature impacts:
- [ ] Backend (FastAPI, Python 3.12, SQLAlchemy, Alembic)
- [ ] Frontend (React, Vite, `/static/` asset routing)
- [ ] Browser Extension (`extension/`)
- [ ] AI Integration (Gemini API, prompts, resume/cover letter generator)
- [ ] Database & Storage (SQLite, `data/copilot.db`, migrations)
- [ ] Tooling, CI/CD, or Documentation

## Security & Privacy Considerations
Does this feature affect the local-only security posture (loopback `127.0.0.1`), introduce external network calls, handle sensitive profile/resume data, or require new API credentials?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or user flows here.
